local p = {}

local tags = {
	m = "{{Meta Unit}}",
	l = "{{Limited Unit}}",
	n = "{{Recent Unit}}",
	bl = "{{Meta Bleed Unit}}",
	bn = "{{Meta Burn Unit}}",
	sp = "{{Meta Support Unit}}",
	s = "{{Story Meta Unit}}",
	r = "{{Raid Meta Unit}}",
	i = "{{Infinite Castle Meta Unit}}",
	u = "{{Unobtainable Unit|",
}

local unitData = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data')
local characterMap = mw.loadData('Module:InfoChar/Data')
local aoeData = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data/AoE_Type') -- Load AoE data
local infoChar = require('Module:InfoChar/Test')

p.descriptions = {}

local dpsThresholds = {
    { threshold = 15000, category = "Low" },
    { threshold = 25000, category = "Average" },
    { threshold = 35000, category = "High" },
    { threshold = 45000, category = "Extreme" },
    { threshold = math.huge, category = "Peak" },
}

local spaCategories = {
    { threshold = 5, category = "Low" },
    { threshold = 9, category = "Average" },
    { threshold = 13, category = "High" },
    { threshold = 21, category = "Very High" },
    { threshold = math.huge, category = "Slow" },
}

local rangeCategories = {
    { threshold = 25, category = "Small" },
    { threshold = 35, category = "Average" },
    { threshold = 45, category = "Big" },
    { threshold = 50, category = "Huge" },
    { threshold = math.huge, category = "Colossal" },
}

local aoeSizeCategories = {
    { threshold = 8, category = "Small" },
    { threshold = 15, category = "Average" },
    { threshold = 21, category = "Big" },
    { threshold = 31, category = "Huge" },
    { threshold = math.huge, category = "Colossal" },
}

local function categorizeValue(value, categories)
    for _, category in ipairs(categories) do
        if value < category.threshold then
            return category.category
        end
    end
    return "Unknown"
end

local function generateAutomatedDescription(characterName, frame)
    local info = characterMap[characterName]
    if not info then
        return "Error: Character not found in characterMap."
    end

    local unitId = info.name
    local data = unitData[unitId]

    if not data then
        return "Error: Unit data not found."
    end

    local dps, _, _ = infoChar.calculateDPS(unitData, characterMap, characterName)
    local dpsCategory = "Not Available"
    if dps then
        for _, thresholdData in ipairs(dpsThresholds) do
            if dps < thresholdData.threshold then
                dpsCategory = thresholdData.category
                break
            end
        end
    end

    local spa = data.attack_cooldown or info.attack_cooldown
    local spaCategory = "Not Available"
    if spa then
        spaCategory = categorizeValue(spa, spaCategories)
    end

    local range = data.range or info.range
    local rangeCategory = "Not Available"
    if range then
        rangeCategory = categorizeValue(range, rangeCategories)
    end

    local aoeType = "Not Available"
    local attackName
    if data.upgrade and data.upgrade[#data.upgrade] and data.upgrade[#data.upgrade].primary_attack then
        attackName = data.upgrade[#data.upgrade].primary_attack
    elseif data.primary_attack_no_upgrades then
        attackName = data.primary_attack_no_upgrades
    end
    if attackName then
        local attackData = aoeData[attackName]
        if attackData and attackData.AOE_TYPE then
            aoeType = attackData.AOE_TYPE
            if aoeType == 'AoE (Circle)' and attackData.radius then
                aoeType = categorizeValue(attackData.radius, aoeSizeCategories) .. " AoE Circle"
            end
        end
    end

    local placementCap = data.spawn_cap or info.placement_cap or "Unknown"

    local description = string.format(
        "%s DPS, %s AoE, %s Range, %s SPA and %s Placements.",
        dpsCategory, aoeType, rangeCategory, spaCategory, placementCap
    )

    return description
end

local function getDescription(characterName, frame, descriptionType)
    local description
    if descriptionType == "story" then
        description = p.story_desc[characterName]
    elseif descriptionType == "mansion" then
    	description = p.mansion_desc[characterName]
    else
        -- Check if manual description exists
        if p.descriptions[characterName] then
            description = p.descriptions[characterName]
        else
            -- Generate automated description
            description = generateAutomatedDescription(characterName, frame)
        end
    end

    if description then
        return frame:preprocess(description)
    else
        return nil
    end
end

function p.getDescription(frame, characterName)
    return getDescription(characterName, frame)
end

function p.getStoryDesc(frame, characterName)
    return getDescription(characterName, frame, "story")
end

function p.getMansionDesc(frame, characterName)
    return getDescription(characterName, frame, "mansion")
end

-- Function to get custom DPS data based on character *name* (from InfoChar/Data)
function p.getCustomDPS(characterName)
    return p.customDPS[characterName]
end

return p
